utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, Nell — I can do sorting donations. Just point me where to start, and I’ll jump in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, thanks — I’m still only hearing bits and pieces, so any update helps. If you can start with the donation pile, I’ll try to find out what else they still need.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect — I’ll start with the donation pile and keep it simple. Just give me a nudge if there’s anything else you need.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I haven’t seen the full list yet, but I can check what’s still needed and let you know. I’ll send a quick update once I’ve gone through the supplies.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Cleo — that’d help a lot. I might’ve missed the latest list, but I can check it too and compare notes.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good — I’ll check what we have and send you the missing items. Once you compare notes, we should have a clear list for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can bring the basic tools and help sort the donations. Just tell me when and where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’s great, Leo — come by the community shed tomorrow at 10, and we’ll sort the donations there.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll be there tomorrow at 10 at the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help—just point me to the supplies or the follow-ups, and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Mara — I’ll point you to the supplies and the follow-ups right away. Let’s get started.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great — I’m on it, just tell me where to begin.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So can you confirm the repair drive is still on, and that we’re doing 2 o’clock at the community center side entrance?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes — the repair drive is still on, and 2 o’clock at the community center side entrance works.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming. I’ll go with 2 o’clock at the community center side entrance.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, definitely—bring that wobbly chair by. I’m sure they’ll have room, and it’s exactly the kind of little fix the drive is great for!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—I'll bring the chair and a few tools first thing. If we keep a simple list of the biggest fixes, we can stay on track.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s a great idea, Eli—having a simple list will keep everything moving. I’ll jot down the chair and any other big fixes folks mention.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Opal — just a quick hand loading and dropping off supplies, if you can swing by the lot this afternoon. That’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can swing by the lot this afternoon—just send me the exact spot and what needs loading so I can plan it. If there’s anything urgent, I’ll make sure that goes first.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’ll send the exact spot and a quick list of what’s urgent. Thanks, Opal, that helps a lot.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo — I’m grateful for the help. If you can bring the tools and sort the donations, that would really take a weight off me.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I can bring the tools and sort the donations. Just send me the lot details and I’ll swing by this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Bo. I’ll send the lot details over now, and I really appreciate you coming by this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m happy to help coordinate the repair drive around school pickup. What drop-off time were you thinking, and which items still need to be brought?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Faye — I’m not sure on the drop-off time yet, but Gus mentioned a ladder, a drill, and a few screwdrivers are still needed. I can check what I have and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds good — thanks for checking. Once you know the drop-off time, I can help fit it around the school pickup schedule.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep reminding folks about the repair drive and pass the word along when I talk to Rosa too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — that would be a big help. If you hear of any urgent safety repairs or neighbors who rely on their equipment, send them my way and I’ll add them first.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep an ear out for urgent safety repairs and pass the word along to Rosa right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good — I’ll be ready at 3 PM at my place.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — 3 PM at your place works, Mina, and I’ll let everyone know the plan. We’ll keep the tools and supplies organized so it’s easy to jump in.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Quinn — that helps a lot. See you at 3 PM, and I’ll have everything ready.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, as long as we keep the drop-off at the community center side entrance around 2 o’clock so I know where to bring things.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good, Pia — I’ll stick to the community center side entrance around 2. I can help sort the biggest repairs and list the materials we need.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps — can you let me know who’s bringing what, so I can put things in the right spot?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard the details yet, but I’m happy to help if you tell me what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I still need the time, what we’re bringing, and exactly where to drop it off so I don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I don’t have the full details yet either, but I can ask around and let you know as soon as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Kira — we’re still rounding up a ladder, a drill, and a few screwdrivers for the repair drive. If you’ve got any of those, let me know and I’ll coordinate the rest.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but can you confirm the time and drop-off spot before we bring anything? I just want to make sure it’s still 2 o’clock at the community center side entrance.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yes — it’s still 2 o’clock at the community center side entrance. Bring whatever you can, and I’ll handle the rest of the coordination.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, definitely bring that wobbly chair by—there’s usually room, and they’ll be glad to help. It’s exactly the kind of small fix that makes the whole drive worthwhile.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll put together a quick list of needed items and the drop-off spot so we can share it around.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be wonderful, Jules — a clear list will make it so much easier for folks to pitch in. I can help spread the word around the neighborhood too!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I can check the repair drive details, but I want to be sure I’m confirming the right thing—what exactly do you need me to verify?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Just please verify the repair drive details and I’ll keep telling everyone about it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll verify the repair drive details first, and then I’ll let you know what I confirm.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — 3 PM at my place works. See you then.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect — 3 PM at your place works for me. Thanks again for helping keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: See you at 3, Ira. Thanks for making it easy to keep this moving.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure — I’ll check the repair drive details and let you know what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Noah — I’m happy to help once you’ve got the details. Let’s start with the biggest repairs and make a simple materials list.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll check what the biggest repairs are and put together a simple materials list.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Could you confirm the drop-off time and which items are still needed? I want to make sure I share the right details around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — it’s this Saturday at 10, and we still need gloves, tape, and any spare tools. Please share that it’s all going by the curb near the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll share that it’s this Saturday at 10 by the curb near the community shed, and that gloves, tape, and spare tools are still needed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can take either one — just point me to the supplies or the follow-ups, and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Mara — the follow-ups are probably the most helpful right now. I’ll point you to the list and the supplies.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great — I’ll start on the follow-ups. Point me to the list and I’ll get going right away.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—just send me the list of biggest repairs, and I’ll bring the tools first thing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect — I’ll send over the biggest repairs now. Thanks, Eli; I really appreciate you bringing the tools first thing.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great — I’ll keep it simple and be ready first thing. Send the list when you can, and I’ll bring the tools.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Leo — I’m still piecing it together, so if you hear what they need most, please let me know.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll let you know if I hear anything. If you need me, I can still bring the basic tools and help sort donations.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, Leo — thanks. I can help sort once I know what’s most needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would help a lot, Opal — I’m putting urgent safety repairs at the top, then neighbors who rely on their equipment every day. If anyone comes to mind, send them my way and I’ll add them to the list.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That sounds right — I’ll keep an eye out for anyone with urgent safety issues or who depends on their equipment daily, and send them your way.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Opal — that’ll help me keep the list focused. I’m going to start matching folks to the repair drive now, so send any names my way as soon as you think of them.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can help with sorting donations — just point me to the table and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect — just tell me where the lot is and I’ll help load and drop things off this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks, Bo — I’m not sure I’ve got the lot details handy, but I can check with Mara and let you know. If you find the address first, just send it my way.
